findings.fact: Entity-only raw string is subject_surface + one space + object_surface, in subject/object order, with newly assigned character spans. Original context and original entity positions are not retained in this branch.
findings.consequence: Fixed ordered entity surface strings imply identical entity-only strings and spans even when context wordpiece lengths differ. Identical tokenization/model settings and deterministic evaluation are additional premises for identical nuisance scores.

findings.fact: The public demo applies softmax to factual and entity-only logits before final addition. Its entity coefficient is -1.6 and its second precomputed term coefficient is +0.1.
findings.consequence: Cancellation concerns corrected probability-space scores. It is not an identity for raw logit differences. Neither fixed demo coefficient is adopted or fit here.

findings.fact: The second nuisance vector and label constraint come from precomputed preprocess.data; their producers are absent from the inspected two source files.
findings.consequence: Their equality across edited hypothetical inputs is unverified. No asset was loaded/unpickled and no full corrected-score invariance claim is made.

findings.fact: The demo restricts to challenge examples using gold labels and entity-only argmax.
findings.consequence: No executed evaluation or performance statement from this code is imported into the Q-RMEA validation audit.

conditional_identity.definition: For raw demo scores S(x)=P(x)-1.6 Q(e)+0.1 R(x)+C(x), P=softmax(factual logits), Q=softmax(entity-only logits).
conditional_identity.identity: With the same ordered entity surfaces and identical deterministic tokenization/evaluation, S(x2)-S(x1)=P(x2)-P(x1)+0.1*(R(x2)-R(x1))+(C(x2)-C(x1)).
conditional_identity.additional_condition: Only if R(x2)=R(x1) and C(x2)=C(x1), the full score difference equals the factual probability-vector difference.
conditional_identity.meaning: A common correction can change hard decisions by changing their offset while preserving this probability-space difference under the additional condition. It need not preserve raw-logit differences, final argmax, or final-normalized probabilities.
conditional_identity.novelty: Elementary known constant-vector cancellation, not a theorem contribution or L5.
